decision: Adopt an explicit semantic substrate for Central rather than relying on dashboard inference for durable relationships.
context: The dashboard exposed the need to distinguish authoritative repository relationships from navigation heuristics and to make state history semantically inspectable.
alternatives: Keep all relationships inferred by the dashboard
Introduce explicit typed entities, relations, threads, events and snapshots
rationale: Structured records are inspectable, testable, provenance-bearing and usable by interfaces other than the dashboard.
review_trigger: If the semantic model becomes materially harder to maintain than the value it provides.

decision: Treat historical communication records as legacy data and add explicit threading without rewriting historical content into invented certainty.
context: The existing ledger predates stable thread IDs.
alternatives: Retroactively invent exact threads for every historical message
Introduce explicit thread registry and use explicit IDs for new records while retaining a legacy mapping for old records
rationale: Preserves historical integrity while creating a clean semantic path forward.
review_trigger: When all active communication producers can emit stable message and thread IDs.

decision: Use one canonical forward forum model composed of modern messages plus a thread registry, while retaining the original ledger and initial seed as historical migration evidence.
context: The first forum implementation introduced a competing forum.jsonl stream. Review found that Central already had an explicit thread registry and a legacy ledger.
alternatives: Maintain forum.jsonl as a second source of truth
Rewrite the historical ledger into modern records
Adopt messages.jsonl and threads.jsonl for new discussion and preserve older records unchanged
rationale: Prevents schema divergence, preserves historical integrity, and gives dashboard views one canonical discussion substrate.
review_trigger: When a later coordination architecture provides a demonstrably stronger canonical message/thread store.

decision: Separate implementation from verification in structured work items.
context: Repository state can show that code or documents exist without establishing that acceptance criteria were checked.
alternatives: Maintain explicit work status and review records
rationale: Keeps completion claims falsifiable and makes stale or unverified work visible to humans and agents.
review_trigger: If the work/review model proves too costly or cannot represent real coordination.
